Zool. 3(1); source identifier new-genera-and-new-species-of-nasutitermitinae-1985), originally in English; the material comprises a Soldier description and a measurements section; the worker appears only in a figure caption (mandible figures 22—24) with no description in the text, so no Worker section is given. The source package did not include the paper's title page, so the authors and title could not be verified. Etymological remarks, collection locality records and acknowledgements are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to pale yellowish brown, slightly darker near the base of the nasus and the postclypeus; nasus, postclypeus and mandibular bases brown to yellowish brown, the nasus slightly darker; postmentum yellow; labrum brownish; mandibles (except at the base) dark reddish brown to brown, darker apically, almost black. Head setae as in the figure. Anterior margin of the pronotum with 6—8 long setae, posterior margin with 8—10 near the ends, disc with 5—6; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum with long setae; metanotal disc with several long setae; abdominal tergites and sternites with numerous long setae, arranged roughly in 3 transverse rows; on the posterior half of each sternite some setae are longer, erect but directed forwards. Sides of the head capsule weakly convex, posterior margin convex. Nasus about half as long as the head capsule (excluding the postclypeus), not reaching the tips of the mandibles, not upturned. In lateral view the lower margin of the head capsule and the lower margin of the nasus are nearly parallel. Antennal segments II, III and V subequal in length, segment IV slightly shorter than segment V, segments VI—XIV slightly longer and slightly thicker. Anterior margin of the pronotum deeply concave in the middle, posterior margin convex, nearly straight only in the middle. Outer side of the fore coxa without a projection. Measurements (mm, type colony, 8 soldiers): head length to apex of nasus 3.23; head length to apex of postclypeus 2.20—2.37; head length to lateral base of mandible 2.33—2.40; nasus length 1.07; head width 1.90—2.00; head height (excluding nasus and postmentum) 1.36—1.47; pronotum width 1.20; hind tibia length 1.43—1.48. Indices: head length to apex of nasus/head width 1.61—1.70; head length to apex of postclypeus/head width 1.16—1.18; nasus length/head length to apex of postclypeus 0.38—0.40; nasus length/head length to base of nasus 0.46—0.48.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type material: holotype soldier, 7 paratype soldiers and workers, deposited in the author's collection (no. 0313); Itabira, Minas Gerais, Brazil, day 14 of month 1, 1983, collected by M. A. Drumond, from a mound in a slash pine (Pinus elliotti) plantation of the Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.
